text:
Kara: flagging an issue from last night's invoice run (run_2026_03_25_02). Several customers got invoices with missing prorated seat lines and a few had tax lines double-counted. Also saw duplicated PDFs for 7 accounts. opening thread for triage.
Ben: thanks. can you drop sample invoice ids and affected accounts?
Kara: samples: INV-ORBIT-0210 (acct-orbit-55), INV-GLIDE-330 (acct-glidecorp), INV-TRI-800 (acct-triage). run id run_2026_03_25_02.
Tasha: support received first complaint from Orbit at 06:48 PT. they attached a PDF that's missing the middle "Seat charges" table. ticket FIN-10211 created.
Marco: I pulled the invoice-generator logs. There's a sequence bug when applying tax calculations after line-item aggregation: in some runs the tax post-process ran twice, producing doubled tax amount lines; in others the aggregation step aborted early producing missing prorated-seat lines. The duplication correlates with retry events.
Marco: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-25T06:46:12Z ERROR invoice_agg: AggregationAborted invoice=INV-ORBIT-0210 reason=timeout
2026-03-25T06:46:13Z WARN retry: requeued stage=aggregation idempotency_key=null
2026-03-25T06:46:14Z INFO tax_calc: applied_tax_line invoice=INV-GLIDE-330 tax_usd=23.45
2026-03-25T06:46:15Z INFO tax_calc: applied_tax_line invoice=INV-GLIDE-330 tax_usd=23.45
```
Ben: that explains both symptoms. two parallel problems: 1) missing lines when aggregation aborts and the downstream renderer receives a partial invoice object; 2) idempotency not enforced for tax stage causing duplicate tax lines when retries occur.
Kara: affected customer list from initial support sweep: acct-orbit-55, acct-glidecorp, acct-triage, acct-zen-201, acct-nova-10, acct-sparrow-7 (total 42 invoices flagged, 7 duplicates confirmed). putting a hold on collections for these.
Tasha: collections hold applied to flagged accounts.
Marco: proposed fix: ensure idempotency_key is threaded through all pipeline stages, make aggregation stage transactional (commit state only on success), and add a dedupe guard in tax_calc (check existing tax lines by idempotency_key). estimate 2 hours including backfill.
Ben: can we pause the nightly run until patch is deployed?
Marco: pausing now. ran: `ssh infra@batch03 "systemctl stop invoice-nightly"` — job paused. :white_check_mark:
FinanceBot: Deploy started for branch billing/tax-idempotency-fix -> staging
Tasha: support messaging: we'll hold until regen is done; offer $15 courtesy credit. drafting template.
Marco: dry-run backfill results: `python billing/backfill.py --run run_2026_03_25_02 --dry-run` -> found 42 incomplete invoices, 7 duplicate tax-line cases.
Ben: rough exposure estimate?
Kara: quick calc ~ $1,240 total (tax overcharges + missing seat proration). finance will prepare provisional credit batch.
FinanceBot: Deploy to production succeeded for billing/tax-idempotency-fix @ 2026-03-25T08:12:05Z
Marco: prod backfill finished: regenerated 42 invoices, deduped 7 tax-lines, replaced PDFs in invoice-store, queued resend. summary:
```
backfill_summary: regenerated=42, deduped_tax_lines=7, duration=41m
```
Tasha: CS will send corrected invoices this afternoon with the $15 credit. template posted in #support.
Ben: finance please prepare journals and credit memos. tagging @Kara for final sign-off.
Kara: approved. Amanda from finance will post journals after CS confirms sends. owners: Marco (fix and backfill), Tasha (customer comms), Ben (finance ops). please add postmortem once incident closed.
